name: Tbilisi
summary: Tbilisi is the nomads' best kept secret. 0% taxes for foreigners for the first year, very low cost of living, fascinating culture, unique cuisine and a nomadic community that has exploded since 2022. Georgia allows visa-free entry to most countries.
strengths: Low cost of livingEUR 574/month — 33% below the average of the 90 cities
